notes.title: October 7 Update Notes:
notes.content:
1. The level completion rewards are now selected in an open card format.
2. Fixed an issue where the Triangular Emblem sometimes failed to trigger.
3. Added a new magic: Summoning, which guarantees the summoned hero will appear in the player's hand during the first turn.
4. Optimized and fixed some known bugs.

notes.title: October 6 Update Notes:
notes.content:
1.Optimized the icon for the enhancement scroll to make it easier to recognize.
2.Removed some negative effects generated by miracle cards.
3.Optimized the logic for the magic card "Smelting."
4.Improved the settlement speed of the gold interface when obtaining large amounts of gold (I really didn’t expect you to be able to earn 999,999+ gold at once!).
5.The copy staff can no longer replicate the matte effect.
6.Fixed several bugs.

notes.title: October 5 Update Notes:
notes.content:
1.Reduced the health of the boss in Level 13.
2.When the player defeats the boss in Level 10, they are rewarded with a selectable mid-tier equipment chest.
3.When the player defeats the boss in Level 15, they are rewarded with a selectable high-tier equipment chest.
4.When the player defeats the boss in Level 20, they are rewarded with one selectable legendary equipment.
5.The ESC key serves as a shortcut to open the settings menu.

notes.title: Patch Notes for October 4 Update
notes.content:
1.Optimized the balance of Endless Mode.
2.Enhanced base array attributes.
3.Refined Emblem: Gain 20 gold coins instantly.
